# `qwen9-data-value`

## Recommended additional gate

Add a **leave-one-out semantic-witness redundancy gate** for each generated
lesson bundle. Materialize the normal `n_demos + n_queries` labeled pairs, hold
out every pair once as the query, and require every declared rival that changes
that query to be refuted by the remaining demonstrations. Also report which
semantic witness disappeared when a rotation fails.

## Concrete failure it would catch

This review produced a clean production-order result—300/300 lessons with zero
ambiguity—while the same materialized lessons had 269/1,200 ambiguous query
rotations. In 201 rotations, holding out the only non-8 pair let
`apply_rule_only_when_input_color_is_8` survive. In 68 rotations, holding out
the only multiple-repeated-class pair let `only_first_repeated_class_is_blue`
survive. A model trained on reordered, packed, or resampled examples could learn
those shortcuts even though every label was correct.

Evidence: `checks/lesson-census-final.json` and the failing regression in
`checks/tdd-red-rotation-identifiability.log`. The repaired four-profile schedule
passes 300 production lessons and all 1,200 rotations in
`checks/lesson-census-final-v2.summary.json`.

## Plausible false positive

A task may intentionally be order-sensitive, or a downstream pipeline may
contractually fix one pair as the query and never rotate/reorder the bundle. In
that case a rival that survives a prohibited rotation does not necessarily lower
training value. The gate should therefore be strict only when the assembly
contract permits query rotation; otherwise it should emit a scoped warning with
the declared ordering policy.

## Cheapest useful test

For each task and band, sample at least 20 consecutive four-pair windows (or one
full declared schedule period, whichever is larger). Reuse the four labels,
rotate the query through all positions, and call the existing
`lesson_identifiable` plus declared-rival scorer. Fail on any query-changing
survivor. A cheap precheck can count witness multiplicity: every obligation that
may be held out should appear in at least two pairs. This requires no new model
inference and reuses the canonical runner and current rival declarations.
